synthesis: Discrepancies exist between sources for 2024 global growth: the Economic Survey highlights an IMF projection of 3.2 per cent for 2024, whereas the RBI Annual Report cites global economic growth of 3.3 per cent in 2024. Historically, global growth reached 3.3 per cent in 2023 (Econ Survey) and averaged 3.7 per cent over 2000-19 (RBI Report).
